stock_uncle_insight.date_header: 8/29 法人與主力大戶主要買超股票

buyer_groups.group_title: 1. 外資大戶：狂掃權值、金融與面板，避險意味濃

stocks.description: 肖年仔，你看外資這手筆！狂掃聯電 8.9 萬張，這不是黑白買，擺明是看好半導體二線廠的低基期補漲，或是對AI題材的延伸布局，準備卡位啦！
外資大買第一金 4.3 萬張，金融股就是資金的避風港，大盤震盪時，這些穩定的金雞母最受青睞，穩穩賺股息，不求大富大貴，但求安穩啦。
兆豐金也被外資敲進 4.2 萬張，跟第一金一樣，都是金融股的代表，外資這波操作很明顯，就是把錢從高風險的股票抽出來，轉進這些「定存概念股」避險。
連 0050 這種大盤型 ETF 外資都買了 4.1 萬張，這代表什麼？就是對大盤整體還是看好，但又不想單壓個股，用 ETF 來分散風險，聰明啦！
面板雙虎之一的群創，外資也買了 2.3 萬張，這檔之前跌到脫褲子，現在外資開始回補，是不是面板產業要谷底翻身了？肖年仔，這要好好觀察。
友達也被外資買超 1.4 萬張，跟群創一樣，面板股被外資看上，可能是覺得跌無可跌，準備來個波段操作，但這種股票要小心，別接刀接到手軟。

buyer_groups.group_title: 2. 投信大戶（本土國家隊）：作帳行情啟動，鎖定傳產與半導體

stocks.description: 投信大買南亞 8.5 千張，這檔塑化龍頭，通常是投信作帳的好標的，穩健又具備一定的流動性，肖年仔，這就是國家隊的「隱形冠軍」啦。
聯電不只外資買，投信也敲進 3.9 千張，三大法人同步買超，這就不是黑白買了，代表聯電的價值被重新評估，可能是看好其成熟製程的訂單能見度。
長興也被投信買了 2.2 千張，這檔化學材料股，通常是景氣復甦的領先指標，投信會買，可能是在為下一波景氣循環做準備。
華通被投信買超 1.9 千張，PCB產業跟電子產品息息相關，投信買進，可能是看好下半年電子產品出貨動能，或是AI伺服器相關板卡的訂單。
中信金也獲得投信 1.9 千張的青睞，跟外資一樣，投信也把金融股當作穩健配置的一環，在市場震盪時，金融股就是最好的防禦型標的。

buyer_groups.group_title: 3. 內資主力與實戶：短線衝刺面板，跟風半導體

stocks.description: 自營商狂敲群創 2.6 千張，這跟外資的動作不謀而合，但自營商的單通常比較短線，可能是看準面板股的短線反彈，準備隔日沖或拉高出貨，韭菜們要小心別追高。
聯電連自營商都買了 1.1 千張，三大法人都進場，這檔股票的動能不容小覷，自營商通常是避險盤，但這次也跟著買，代表對聯電的短期走勢有信心。
台玻被自營商買超 9 百張，這檔傳產股，通常不會是自營商的主力戰場，但這次進場，可能是看好其資產題材或特定訂單，短線操作的機會比較大。
友達也被自營商買了 7 百張，跟群創一樣，自營商對面板雙虎的短線行情很有興趣，但這種股票波動大，肖年仔別亂接刀，小心被割韭菜。
日月光投控被自營商買超 6 百張，這檔半導體封測龍頭，是AI供應鏈的重要一環，自營商進場，可能是看好其在AI晶片封測的潛力，但也是短線操作居多。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：資金避風港與權值股防禦（金融、大型ETF）
strategies.strategy_content: 肖年仔，你看外資大買金融股（第一金、兆豐金、華南金）和 0050，投信也跟著買中信金、國泰金。這很明顯，當大盤震盪、國際情勢不明朗時，大戶們會把資金從高風險的股票撤出來，轉進這些相對穩健、有高殖利率題材的金融股，或是直接買進大盤型 ETF 避險。這就是典型的「高檔避險」操作，不求爆賺，但求穩健，避免被市場割韭菜。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：低基期產業復甦卡位（面板、傳產）
strategies.strategy_content: 面板雙虎（群創、友達）這次被外資和自營商同步買超，連台玻這種傳產股也動起來。這代表什麼？這些股票之前跌到阿嬤都不想買，現在可能看到產業谷底翻揚的跡象，或是評價面已經夠低了。主力大戶就是喜歡在大家不看好的時候偷偷布局，等利空出盡、產業復甦時，再拉高出貨，肖年仔，這就是「低基期卡位」的精髓啦！

strategies.strategy_title: 策略三：AI半導體供應鏈再佈局（聯電、京元電、日月光投控）
strategies.strategy_content: 國際新聞Nvidia財報這麼猛，AI題材根本沒退燒！你看聯電被三大法人狂掃，京元電子、日月光投控也都有法人買超。這說明資金又重新回流到AI相關的半導體供應鏈，特別是那些相對低價、有補漲空間的二線晶圓代工和封測廠。大戶們在找尋AI題材的「下一棒」，肖年仔，這就是新技術題材點火的訊號，但也要小心追高變接刀。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略四：高檔獲利了結與避險（記憶體、航太、部分AI概念股）
strategies.strategy_content: 外資、投信、自營商同步賣超華邦電，外資和自營商也倒貨漢翔。這很明顯，這些股票之前漲了一大段，現在主力大戶覺得差不多了，開始「拉高出貨」或「避險」。特別是華邦電，記憶體產業前景不明，加上之前漲多，主力當然要先跑為快。肖年仔，看到這種現象，別傻傻去接刀，小心被「融資斷頭」啊！

stock_uncle_insight.summary: 肖年仔，今天大戶們的操作很清楚，就是把錢從漲多的高風險股撤出來，轉進穩健的金融、低基期的面板，同時也沒放過AI半導體供應鏈的補漲機會，這就是典型的「進可攻退可守」策略，別再黑白買了！

top_brokerages_analysis.uncle_logic: 美商高盛這種外資大咖，一次敲進聯電 3.1 萬張，這絕對不是短線操作。他們看的是聯電在半導體成熟製程的長期價值，或是對其在AI邊緣運算等新應用上的潛力有信心，準備長期鎖碼啦！
凱基台北這分點，肖年仔你聽過吧？著名的「隔日沖」大戶！買超群創 1 千多張，擺明了就是準備明天開盤拉高出貨，想賺短線價差。韭菜們，別傻傻跟進，小心變成他們的提款機！
元大投信自家分點買南亞 3.8 千張，這就是典型的「作帳行情」啦！投信為了年底績效，會鎖定一些有基本面、股價相對穩定的傳產股來拉抬，幫自己的基金衝刺淨值。肖年仔，這就是國家隊的盤算。
摩根大通這種外資大戶，賣超華邦電 9.3 千張，這就不是開玩笑的。可能是對記憶體產業的展望保守，或是華邦電之前漲多了，他們覺得獲利了結的時機到了，準備把資金轉移到其他更有潛力的標的，這就是「避險」操作，先跑為快！

english_professor_news.title: Bank of America doubles down on Nvidia stock
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Nvidia reported earnings on Aug. 26. Wall Street expected it to beat. Bank of America was not particularly interested in that part of the story.

The firm's note, published ahead of the report, was really about one thing: whether the market had correctly priced the scale of what Nvidia has been doing with its balance sheet.

The answer, according to Bank of America, was no. The results Nvidia delivered made that argument harder to dismiss.

In a note shared with TheStreet on Aug. 25, analyst Vivek Arya reiterated a Buy rating and a $350 price target on Nvidia, implying roughly 64% upside from where the stock was trading that day.

ALSO READ: NVIDIA Corp. Q2 2027 Earnings: Live Updates of $NVDA Earnings Call, Forecast

Nvidia delivered revenue of $96.2 billion for the second fiscal quarter, up 106% year over year and well above consensus expectations of roughly $92 billion, according to Nvidia's official earnings release. Data center revenue came in at $89 billion, up 117% year over year. Gross margin held at 75%.

"AI has reached its inflection point. It's doing useful work. Its tokens are productive and profitable. Now, compute is revenue," Jensen Huang said on the earnings call. "And demand is accelerating."

Nvidia also returned roughly $26 billion to shareholders in the quarter through buybacks and dividends, with approximately $99 billion remaining under its buyback authorization.

english_professor_news.title: Best credit cards with no annual fee for August 2026
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Why we like it: The Chase Freedom Unlimited is an all-around great cash-back card that's also a smart choice for travel. At a minimum, you'll earn 1.5% cash back on every purchase — but you'll earn even more in select rewards categories, including 5% on travel booked through Chase Travel℠. When you're ready to redeem rewards, you can also use them to book travel with Chase Travel or even combine rewards with another Chase card for a potential travel redemption boost.

For new cardholders, the Chase Freedom Unlimited offers a valuable welcome bonus and a 0% APR on new purchases and balance transfers. Long-term, you'll also get the security of useful Chase purchase protection and travel insurance benefits.

Why we like it: The U.S. Bank Shield Visa Card is our pick for 0% APR because it has one of the longest intro periods you'll find today — whether you want to use your 0% APR for a large purchase or to pay down debt with a balance transfer.

There are also a few benefits to enjoy with this card, including 4% cash back on prepaid air, hotel, and car reservations booked through the U.S. Bank Travel Center and an annual $20 statement credit after you make purchases for 11 consecutive months. However, the U.S. Bank Shield Visa is primarily a great tool for its long-lasting 0% APR period.

Why we like it: The Capital One Savor Cash Rewards card packs a ton of rewards for no annual fee. We think it's great for grocery shopping, with unlimited 3% rewards at grocery stores. But you'll earn the same rate on even more items in your regular budget, including dining at restaurants, entertainment spending, and popular streaming services.

You can also earn 5% rewards on travel when you make eligible bookings (hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars) through Capital One Travel. Plus, earn a great welcome bonus with a relatively low spending requirement and take advantage of an introductory 0% APR on new purchases and balance transfers.

Why we like it: The Amex Blue Cash Everyday Card is one of our favorite cash-back cards today with or without an annual fee. Its rewards at U.S. supermarkets and U.S. gas stations can help you maximize the purchases in your monthly budget, and rewards on U.S. online retail purchases can help you make the most of purchases (whether essentials or splurges) from your favorite online stores.

If you're able to max out the $6,000 spending cap on 3% rewards in each of these categories, you could get $540 in annual cash back. That's a great return for no annual fee. In addition to rewards, this card has a solid welcome bonus and an intro 0% APR on new purchases and balance transfers.

english_professor_news.title: OSI Systems (OSIS) Posted Record Cash Flow and Backlog but Revenue Missed Estimates
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
OSI Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSIS) ended fiscal 2026 with record operating cash flow and backlog, but its fourth-quarter revenue result was materially below expectations. Revenue declined 4% to $484.1 million, approximately $45.6 million below the $529.7 million consensus estimate. Full-year revenue of $1.786 billion also finished about $39 million below the $1.825 billion floor of the company's prior guidance. Company-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.78 was essentially in line with the $3.77 consensus estimate.

Shares closed lower following the revenue miss, Middle Eastern delivery delays, and fiscal 2027 guidance. The central question is whether the delayed sales represent a temporary shift or evidence that the record backlog will convert unevenly.

Fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted EPS increased 3% to $8.95, while company-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 11% to $10.35. The non-GAAP measure excludes impairment, restructuring, and other charges, acquired-intangible amortization, a $4.359 million former-CEO retirement expense, related tax effects, and discrete tax items.

Management said Middle Eastern conflicts and site-access constraints shifted approximately $50 million of planned Security deliveries beyond June 30. OSI Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSIS) said the orders were deferred rather than lost and remain in backlog under revised delivery schedules.

Backlog increased to approximately $1.9 billion from $1.8 billion a year earlier. Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for revenue of $1.875 billion to $1.930 billion, representing growth of 5% to 8.1%. Company-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS is expected between $11.13 and $11.49, implying growth of 7.5% to 11%.

The other divisions add diversification. Fourth-quarter Optoelectronics and Manufacturing revenue increased approximately 5%, while its company-defined non-GAAP operating margin improved to 14.7% from 13.6%. Healthcare revenue rose about 5%, while its company-defined non-GAAP operating margin reached 10% from 0.9%. Those margins exclude impairment, restructuring, and other charges and acquired-intangible amortization.

The $1.9 billion backlog does not provide a specific conversion schedule. OSI Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSIS) defines backlog as signed, quantifiable orders expected to generate revenue within five years. The company says those orders are generally firm but may occasionally be canceled, and backlog should not be treated as revenue guidance for any annual or quarterly period.

Security revenue fell 7.4% to $339.7 million during the fourth quarter despite healthy bookings. Fiscal 2027 growth is also expected to be weighted toward the second half, leaving the outlook exposed if geopolitical disruption or customer-acceptance delays continue.

market_linker_insight.market_connection: 美商高盛和凱基台北之間的買股行為，與國際財經新聞中關於Nvidia的報導有著密切的因果關係。Nvidia的業績超過預期，導致美商高盛對其持有股股的評估上升，凱基台北也跟進買入Nvidia的股股。這些買股行為可能是因為Nvidia的業績超過預期，導致投資人對其持有股的評估上升，進而導致美商高盛和凱基台北對其持有股的買入。這種因果關係可能會對兩者的投資策略產生影響，需要進一步觀察和分析。
